speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; to begin our assessment, how long has the bleeding been occurring, and is the mass palpable or discovered via imaging?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia with Atypia (suspicion of Endometrial Cancer).

I have noted the 2-month history of intermittent bleeding and the absence of systemic symptoms or medication use. Given the patient's age and the presence of an adnexal mass, I need to urgently evaluate the thickness of the uterine lining. REQUEST TEST: Endometrial_Biopsy. Additionally, please provide the ultrasound results detailing the size and characteristics of the adnexal mass. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_Ultrasound.
